propositions: A superseded ticket with a live supersedes/duplicates link cannot be closed via rebar transition --class=superseded because the plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation it cannot earn.
The plan-review gate (gates.py:92) receives no close_class parameter and cannot distinguish administrative dispositions, leaving it blind to the evidence that completion verification already accepts.
A superseded ticket's review-plan will correctly BLOCK because the work already exists elsewhere, making an attestation requirement unsatisfiable by construction.
Administrative closes with live replacement links should skip the plan-review gate when the disposition matches the link evidence, analogous to how completion verification already works.
The fix threads close_class and tracker into close_plan_review_gate_check and exempts only link-backed dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when _has_live_replacement_link returns true.
